document.abstract: The need for a viable data networking solution in production has never been greater. The requirements to handle more production formats and metadata combined with the relentless drive for efficiency is placing the current video infrastructure under pressure. Fast data networks are increasingly available and potentially help solve many problems. To gain the maximum benefit from mainstream network technology it is important that the production environment understands its capabilities and limitations. This paper argues that for many applications the cost and complexity of networks supporting advanced services, such as quality of service, is not warranted and its benefit is outweighed by the interoperability and affordability of simpler solutions. The availability of general purpose high-bandwidth, low latency networks with good vendor support will prove invaluable to the production system designer.
